title: Resolve login password validation contract conflict
description: D-AUTH-01 explicitly defers password complexity and says the frontend must not hard-code it, while the provisional OpenAPI LoginRequest requires password minLength 8 and component guidance requires forms to mirror the contract. Decide whether login accepts any non-empty credential or whether 8 is a ratified login-input invariant. Update the governing auth decision and versioned OpenAPI/provenance/generated types as needed before e06-t01 creates its Zod login schema. Do not silently choose either validation rule.
acceptance_criteria: The product, security, and API contract owners approve one login-password validation rule; D-AUTH-01 and the OpenAPI LoginRequest no longer conflict; any contract change is versioned with provenance and generated types refreshed; e06-t01 can implement the Zod schema without inventing password policy.
close_reason: Resolved: the user selected the existing OpenAPI LoginRequest password bound of 8–200 characters; D-AUTH-01 v1.0.1 now records the matching input invariant.

title: Ratify provisional EIAMS v1 OpenAPI against backend implementation
description:
## Decision

Compare the implemented backend and authoritative Apidog project with
`contracts/openapi/eiams-v1.openapi.json`. Resolve every divergence through an
explicit versioned contract change and publish updated provenance before
production integration.

## Rationale

The provisional snapshot deliberately unblocks mocks and frontend development
while the backend is unfinished. A durable production gate is required so the
design contract cannot silently drift from implemented authorization,
validation, status codes, endpoints, or payloads.

## Alternatives Considered

- Block all frontend work until the backend is complete: rejected because the
  project owner explicitly authorized a provisional design-first contract.
- Patch generated frontend artifacts for backend differences: rejected because
  it destroys deterministic generation and contract traceability.
- Ratify during release review without a dedicated dependency: rejected because
  the gate could be missed and would have no independent acceptance evidence.

## Scope

Ratification only. Preserve the provisional contract for development until
backend evidence exists. Do not patch generated frontend artifacts or silently
accept incompatibilities. Estimate: 240 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Backend/API and frontend contract owners review all 111 operations and shared conventions. Every incompatibility is accepted or corrected through a versioned OpenAPI/provenance update with compatibility impact recorded. Redocly lint, reference audit, deterministic type generation, and Apidog import pass. Production drift enforcement consumes the ratified checksum and no handwritten frontend override remains.
notes: Blocked on external evidence: the implemented backend API and authoritative Apidog project/export do not yet exist. Resume when the backend/API owner can provide an implementation revision and reviewable Apidog contract. This blocker is intentionally release-only; provisional frontend generation and mocks may proceed.

title: Publish provisional EIAMS v1 OpenAPI source snapshot
description: ## Deliverable Publish an architecture-owned provisional OpenAPI 3.0.3 contract for EIAMS v1, derived from the approved PRD, ERD/schema, BDM, and P0 decision artifacts, so it can be imported into Apidog and used for frontend mocks/type generation. Estimate: 240 minutes. ## Rationale The backend API is not yet available and the user explicitly authorized a provisional design contract. The artifact must remain traceable and require backend ratification rather than claiming to describe implemented behavior. ## Acceptance Criteria - A valid OpenAPI 3.0.3 JSON snapshot and provenance file exist at the approved contract paths. - The contract covers common security/errors/pagination/concurrency and every v1 BDM domain needed by the frontend. - Canonical P0 decisions for counterparties, movements, disposal, adjustment, derived status, and SoftFreeze are represented. - The snapshot is structurally validated, imports into OpenAPI-compatible tools, and is suitable for deterministic frontend generation/mocking. - Backend ratification and incompatibility handling are explicit. ## Boundaries This task defines a provisional API contract only; it does not implement backend endpoints or claim they currently exist.
notes: Published contracts/openapi/eiams-v1.openapi.json and eiams-v1.provenance.json as architecture-owned provisional D-OAS-02, plus Apidog/frontend guidance in contracts/openapi/README.md. Coverage: 77 paths, 111 operations, 126 schemas across Auth, Administration, Organization, Catalog, Warehouse, Inventory, Documents, InventoryCount, Adjustment, Asset, Custody, Audit, and Reports. Validation: Redocly recommended lint passed with zero warnings; custom JSON/reference/operation audit found zero missing schema refs and duplicate operationIds; openapi-typescript 7.13.0 generated 5,263 lines; provenance/version/count/SHA-256 checks passed (ab10f8f03c5a4352230be302075cea58ad9f6c1392332be75fb7fac36840dbc0). Updated D-OAS-01, BDM, and conflict matrix. Backend ratification is explicitly pending in eiams-frontend-e01.7, which blocks release drift enforcement but not development generation.
close_reason: Acceptance criteria satisfied: valid provisional OpenAPI/provenance published, full v1 surface and P0 semantics covered, deterministic generation validated, import guidance documented, and backend ratification tracked explicitly.

title: Approve polymorphic counterpart lookup contract
description:
## Decision
Define supported IssueTo and Custody holder target types, lookup endpoints, validation behavior, and external-counterparty identity model for v1.

## Rationale
PRD permits Employee, OrganizationalUnit, Site, and External, but no External entity or lookup contract exists. ERD/schema use incompatible labels and custody type sets.

## Alternatives Considered
Show free-text external values or restrict targets in the frontend. Rejected: both change business semantics and bypass required application-layer validation.

## Acceptance Criteria
Approve v1 target enums, identifiers, lookup/search APIs, inactive-target behavior, validation and error contract, and affected Beads.
notes: Decision artifact: docs/polymorphic-counterpart-lookup-contract-decision.md. Updated docs/requirements-conflict-matrix.md with D-POST-01. Chosen model: UUID-backed active/inactive ExternalParty; Employee personal custody only; OrganizationUnit/Site/External operational custody; server-authoritative scoped lookup and validation. Added eiams-frontend-e09.1 for ExternalParty administration and explicit dependency from e09-t09. Validation: bd lint, bd dep cycles, and bd orphans pass.
close_reason: Published the v1 polymorphic counterpart lookup contract, reconciled type conflicts, and added required ExternalParty administration work.

title: Approve return and asset-movement event contract
description:
## Decision
Define the authoritative stock and asset movement event enums and their creation rules for return and disposal flows.

## Rationale
PRD return posting creates a Receipt movement, but the documented enum does not include Return; derived Disposed state requires an AssetMovementHistory Disposed event that its enum omits. ERD/schema use different legacy vocabularies.

## Alternatives Considered
Map events in the frontend or reuse an arbitrary existing enum. Rejected: ledgers are immutable and event semantics must be backend-contract owned.

## Acceptance Criteria
Approve each document-to-stock and document-to-asset event mapping, enum values, payload fields, derived-status rules, and compatibility guidance for frontend consumers.
notes: Decision artifact: docs/return-asset-movement-event-contract-decision.md. Updated docs/requirements-conflict-matrix.md with D-RAE-01 and U-02 resolution note. Chosen model: Return reuses Receipt; asset events are Received/Issued/Returned/Disposed; no generic Adjusted or v1 Transferred; disposal only deducts stock when the asset remains in warehouse stock. Added direct consumer dependencies. Validation: bd lint, bd dep cycles, and bd orphans pass.
close_reason: Published the canonical return and asset-movement event contract and linked all event consumers.

title: Approve adjustment and disposal workflow contract
description:
## Decision
Define ownership, lifecycle, asset references, signed-copy gate, and posting effects for adjustment and disposal documents.

## Rationale
SAD/PRD settled decisions define a manager-owned adjustment exception, while the PRD disposal flow has a keeper create and submit an Adjustment document. The schema also lacks the required asset-disposal reference and event semantics.

## Alternatives Considered
Reuse the generic document workflow or treat disposal as an undocumented asset action. Both contradict at least one governing source and would create inconsistent authorization.

## Acceptance Criteria
Approve one contract for adjustment and disposal lifecycle, RBAC, fields, events, immutable history, and API payloads; document rejected alternatives and affected Beads.
notes: Published docs/adjustment-workflow-decision.md. It resolves the manager-owned adjustment/disposal lifecycle, purposes and asset-line contract, signed-original post gate, terminal disposal policy, immutable posting/reversal effects, API/read models, rejected alternatives, and consumer blockers. Added direct dependencies from affected policy, count, adjustment, asset, custody, reporting, and verification tasks. Validated with bd lint, bd dep cycles, bd orphans, and git diff --check.
close_reason: Approved and published adjustment/disposal workflow contract with downstream dependencies.

title: Approve v1 inventory-count freeze-policy contract
description:
## Decision
Resolve the v1 supported InventoryCount freeze policies and the frontend behavior for each policy.

## Rationale
The PRD exposes HardFreeze, SoftFreeze, and NoFreeze while Architecture Overview and ERD defer HardFreeze and NoFreeze. The frontend cannot safely offer, suppress, or enforce policies without an approved contract.

## Alternatives Considered
Implement all PRD enum values or restrict v1 to SoftFreeze. Neither can be selected from the conflicting sources alone.

## Acceptance Criteria
Specify the supported v1 enum set, permission and posting behavior, warning/blocking semantics, API representation, rejected alternative, and affected Beads.
notes: Published docs/inventory-count-freeze-policy-decision.md. It approves SoftFreeze as the only v1 policy; defines non-blocking server-computed overlap warnings, roles/lifecycle, generated API/advisory semantics, deferred policies, rejected alternatives, and affected consumers. Added direct dependencies from shared policy, count, adjustment, reporting, and verification tasks. Validated with bd lint, bd dep cycles, bd orphans, and git diff --check.
close_reason: Approved and published v1 inventory-count SoftFreeze contract with downstream dependencies.

title: Publish the canonical BDM and source provenance
description:
## Decision
Establish the canonical Business Domain Model (BDM) artifact, version, owner, and source provenance for EIAMS v1.

## Rationale
The project instructions require BDM alignment, but no BDM artifact is present. Frontend and OpenAPI decisions cannot infer domain rules absent from the PRD and schema.

## Alternatives Considered
Treat the PRD or ERD as an implicit BDM. Rejected: they contain known conflicts and do not define a designated canonical BDM.

## Acceptance Criteria
Publish or formally waive the BDM; list authoritative entities, rules, and provenance; identify changes required to PRD/OpenAPI; and link affected Beads.
notes: Published docs/business-domain-model-v1.md as the versioned, provenance-backed EIAMS v1 BDM planning baseline. It records authority/change control, source provenance, bounded entities/relationships/invariants, decision-backed enum meanings, unresolved contract gaps, PRD/OpenAPI alignment work, affected Beads, and rejected alternatives. Updated requirements conflict matrix to resolve U-06. Validated with bd lint, bd dep cycles, bd orphans, and git diff --check.
close_reason: Published canonical v1 BDM baseline and source provenance with explicit alignment requirements.

title: Contract decision: Issue-line specific-asset reference (assetIds on DocumentLineInput)
description: PRD 12.3 step 3 requires the keeper to 'select the specific asset serial/ID' for asset-type Issue lines, and D-AST-02 derives Issued status per specific asset. title: Ratify low-stock presentation contract
description:
## Decision
Define the authoritative EIAMS v1 low-stock semantics and read contract used by Inventory presentation.

## Rationale
InventoryBalance exposes quantity while WarehouseMaterialSetting exposes nullable min/max/reorder values, but no source defines whether low means quantity below or at a threshold, how missing or inactive settings behave, or how a globally paged low-stock view is queried. The frontend must not join independently paged datasets or invent business rules.

## Alternatives Considered
Client-join the current balance and settings pages or infer quantity less than or equal to minQuantity. Rejected because page-local joins are incomplete and the comparison rule is not contract-backed.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Define the authoritative threshold field and comparison operator.
- Define missing, null, inactive, zero, and scoped-warehouse behavior.
- Add a server-computed low-stock state, filter, or projection to OpenAPI, or document an explicit v1 presentation waiver that remains correct under pagination.
- Define Arabic status semantics and compatibility guidance for eiams-frontend-e14-t06.
notes: Ratified D-INV-READ-01. minQuantity is inclusive (quantity <= threshold); required server lowStock projection defines Low, Sufficient, NotConfigured, and Disabled; missing, null, inactive, zero, scope, Arabic labels, and pre-pagination lowStockState filter are defined. Independent QA PASS. Full pnpm run quality PASS.
close_reason: Accepted server-computed low-stock threshold, state, scope, filter, and Arabic presentation contract is documented, independently QA-reviewed, and fully validated.

title: Ratify Adjustment lifecycle related-document route identity
description: D-LIFE-01 requires a related-document link in lifecycle history. LifecycleDocumentReference exposes warehouse documentId and documentType, while the Adjustment detail route requires InventoryAdjustment.adjustmentId; OpenAPI defines adjustmentId and documentId as distinct. The frontend must not substitute documentId into :adjustmentId or infer a compensating type. Decide and expose an authoritative navigation identity or route projection for Adjustment references.
acceptance_criteria: The admitted contract defines how a LifecycleDocumentReference with documentType=Adjustment resolves to an authorized frontend detail route (for example by exposing adjustmentId or a documentId lookup route); generated types and route integration tests prove the mapping; e15-t05 can render the required link without identity inference.
notes: User ratified additive contract on 2026-08-21: LifecycleDocumentReference.adjustmentId is the authoritative optional route identity, present by invariant for documentType=Adjustment and absent for WarehouseDocument routes. Implemented OpenAPI provisional.7 + provenance/checksum/evidence, regenerated types, D-LIFE documentation, Adjustment timeline routing with non-inference fallback, and canonical MSW compensation coverage with distinct IDs. Contract validation passed zero warnings; focused tests 32/32; full quality passed 157 files/951 tests and build after one isolated pre-existing app-shell timeout passed on retry.
close_reason: Contract decision ratified and implemented with generated types, authoritative route integration, fallback, and validation evidence.

title: Ratify inventory balance detail contract
description:
## Decision
Define the authoritative read contract and route identity for the inventory balance detail page.

## Rationale
The e14-t03 deliverable requires a balance detail page, but OpenAPI exposes only GET /inventory/balances and no GET /inventory/balances/{balanceId}. The frontend must not infer whether detail is addressed by balanceId or a warehouse/material projection.

## Alternatives Considered
Fetch the list and locate a row client-side, or invent a detail endpoint. Rejected because pagination cannot guarantee the row is present and uncontracted endpoints violate the source-of-truth rules.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Approve either a typed balance-detail endpoint or an explicit warehouse/material-filtered list projection.
- Define route parameters, 404 behavior, scope behavior, and response schema.
- Update OpenAPI/generated types and record compatibility guidance for e14-t03.
notes: Ratified D-INV-READ-01. Added GET /inventory/balances/{balanceId} with required UUID identity, InventoryBalance response, 400/401/403/404 behavior, and indistinguishable 404 for missing versus out-of-scope resources. Independent QA PASS. Full pnpm run quality PASS.
close_reason: Accepted balance detail identity and scope-concealing error contract is documented, encoded in OpenAPI/generated types, independently QA-reviewed, and fully validated.

title: Ratify inventory list sorting contract
description:
## Decision
Define the authoritative server-side sorting contract for inventory balance and stock-movement lists.

## Rationale
SAD and enterprise table guidance require server-side sorting, but GET /inventory/balances and GET /inventory/movements expose no sort parameters in the ratified OpenAPI. Frontend implementation must not invent query names or client-sort paged data.

## Alternatives Considered
Client-sort the current page or invent sortBy/sortDirection parameters. Rejected because paged client sorting is globally incorrect and invented query semantics violate the contract-first architecture.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Approved sort fields and direction vocabulary are added to the OpenAPI operations and generated types, or an explicit v1 waiver is documented.
- Default ordering and tie-break behavior are defined for both lists.
- Compatibility guidance for e14-t02 and e14-t04 is recorded.
notes: Ratified D-INV-READ-01. Added typed balance and movement sort fields, Ascending/Descending directions, invalid-value 400 responses, deterministic defaults and stable tie-breakers to OpenAPI provisional.8 and regenerated types. Independent QA PASS. Full pnpm run quality PASS: 158 files, 959 tests, build PASS.
close_reason: Accepted inventory list sorting contract is documented, encoded in OpenAPI/generated types, independently QA-reviewed, and fully validated.

title: Define and publish v1 material unit-conversion contract
description: e10-t11 cannot implement material unit conversions because OpenAPI provisional.4 has no conversion paths, operations, schemas, generated types, or service surface. Historical sources disagree: PRD/ERD model material-to-base-unit factor, while schema.md describes nullable/global conversions and a different target field. Product/API owner must define the v1 invariant, endpoint paths, read/mutation payloads, precision, unique constraints, scope/RBAC, concurrency, no-delete/change-after-use policy, and document snapshot behavior. Recommended narrow v1: per material, fromUnit to the material base unit only; positive factor with fixed precision; unique material/fromUnit; server rejects base unit/self, inactive/out-of-scope units, duplicate, stale rowVersion, and changes after use unless immutable document snapshot exists. Publish in OpenAPI and regenerate types before frontend work.
notes:
اعتماد المالك 2026-08-14: لكل مادة وحدة أساس واحدة. كل وحدة بديلة (كرتونة/علبة/كيس) تتحول مباشرة إلى وحدة أساس المادة بعامل خاص بها؛ لا يوجد عامل عالمي لوحدة كرتونة. عامل التحويل موجب DECIMAL(18,6). يمنع تحويل وحدة الأساس لنفسها وتكرار conversion النشط لنفس (materialId, fromUnitId). يجب أن يحفظ DocumentLine conversionId/factor/baseQuantity وقت الإنشاء أو الترحيل ولا يعاد تفسير التاريخ بعد تغير التعبئة. يفضل إلغاء/أرشفة التحويل المستخدم وإنشاء بديل جديد، لا الحذف أو الكتابة فوقه. تعتمد endpoints المقترحة وrowVersion والتحقق الخادمي للصلاحية والنطاق.
D-UOM-01 نُشر في OpenAPI 1.0.0-provisional.5: مسارات GET/POST للقائمة وGET/PUT للمفرد بلا DELETE؛ schemas MaterialUnitConversion/CreateRequest/UpdateRequest؛ factor موجب DECIMAL(18,6)، وحدة أساس مشتقة خادمياً، uniqueness/self/scope/active/rowVersion موصوفة تعاقدياً، وتعطيل المستخدم بدلاً من تعديل العامل. DocumentLine يحفظ conversionId(nullable للوحدة الأساسية) وconversionFactor وbaseQuantity كلقطة غير قابلة لإعادة التفسير؛ input يقبل preview اختياريًا والخادم مصدر الحقيقة. تم اجتياز contract:validate وapi:types generate/check.
close_reason: Owner-approved D-UOM-01 is documented, represented in provisional.6 OpenAPI, generated, and independently QAed including exact decimal transport.

title: Define v1 conditional material tracking policy
description: Decision required before implementing e10-t09. OpenAPI MaterialUpsertRequest exposes required independent fields materialKind, trackingType (Quantity|Serial), and requiresAssetNumber; PRD/BDM call them authoritative attributes but state no allowed combinations, no normalization/reset behavior after edits, and no legacy-read semantics. Product/API owner must define valid combinations, whether incompatible field changes are rejected or normalized, and how existing incompatible records display. Do not invent rules such as Asset=>Serial or Serial=>requiresAssetNumber.
design: سياسة مقترحة: اختيار materialKind يقود القيم التابعة. Consumable يفرض trackingType=Quantity وrequiresAssetNumber=false. Durable يفرض requiresAssetNumber=false ويحتاج custodyRequired=true؛ الإصدار الأول يفضل Quantity custody ما لم يضاف كيان TrackedUnit للمتابعة الفردية بلا رقم أصل. Asset يفرض individual/Serial tracking ووجود معرف مؤسسي ثابت؛ يفضل assetNumber إلزامياً وserialNumber اختيارياً. تغيير التصنيف مسموح قبل أول حركة فقط؛ بعد الحركات يقفل على الخادم. تغيير النوع قبل الحفظ يعرض تأكيداً ويعيد تعيين الحقول التابعة؛ السجلات التاريخية غير المتوافقة تعرض بتحذير ولا تطبع بصمت.
notes: اعتماد المالك 2026-08-14: تم اعتماد D-MAT-01. نُشرت السياسة في PRD/BDM/ERD/schema/decision/conflict matrix والعقد OpenAPI provisional.4، مع أنواع مولدة واختبارات UI. عقد Durable custody متعدد الموضوعات موجود في العقد المؤقت؛ تنفيذ الخلفية وتصديقه يبقيان ضمن e01.7 قبل تكامل الإنتاج.
close_reason: Owner approved D-MAT-01; policy is documented, represented in provisional OpenAPI, generated, and independently QAed.

title: Validate employee required fields and external-party status on create
description: EmployeeUpsertRequest requires employeeNumber/fullNameAr non-empty but the zod schema has no min(1), so empty strings pass client validation and surface as 422 inline errors. ExternalPartyUpsertRequest has no status in the form; creation is always Active (acceptable) but verify this matches the product intent.

title: Share page-shell, DetailField and form-submit patterns across organization pages
description: site-detail-page and employee-detail-page duplicate DetailField inline; submitForm + normalizeApiError + toast handling is copy-pasted in 6 pages; ExternalPartySelect calls organizationService directly inside a list component instead of a scoped query hook. Extract shared components/hooks (organization page shell, detail field, form submit hook) to reduce duplication.

title: Invalidate external-party detail queries after mutations
description: use-external-party-mutations invalidates with query key ending in {} which matches list caches only. Employee and org-unit mutations use a clean 'organization' prefix and invalidate both list and detail. Align external-party invalidation to the same prefix pattern.

title: Eliminate favicon.ico 404 in application shell
description: Browser DevTools mobile smoke observed GET /favicon.ico returning 404 and two resource-load console errors. The repository has public/favicon.svg; ensure the application shell/browser icon declaration prevents the .ico fallback or provide the approved compatible asset without altering the binding SVG identity.

title: Receiving form label for= points to non-existent id (a11y)
description: QA found on the new-receiving-document form (browser console): 'Incorrect use of <label for=FORM_ELEMENT>' — a label's for references an id that does not exist in the DOM. Breaks label-click focus and autofill. Find the offending label/id pair on /documents/receiving/new and fix (match id, or use htmlFor to the real input).
acceptance_criteria: Browser console shows no label-for warnings on the new receiving form; clicking the label text focuses the field.

title: Mock parity: enforce signed-original gate on Post; align timeline actor
description: From t06 QA (mock-only, P4): (1) the dev mock allows Post without a signed original uploaded (server gate only re-evaluates on attachment mutations) — real backend enforces D-ATT-01; (2) timeline 'إنشاء الوثيقة' actor is the fixture 'مستخدم تجريبي — أمين المستودع' while createdBy shows the dev session user — actor mismatch on newly created docs in the mock.
acceptance_criteria: Mock Post returns a blocker/422 without a signed original; created-event actor matches the creating session.
notes: Implemented mock parity: unsigned Submitted policy disables Post with Arabic blocker; direct unsigned Post returns 422 without mutation; attachment upload is Draft-only; Created lifecycle event captures the full creating-session actor. Validation: full quality passed (157 files, 955 tests, production build). Independent Brave QA verified unsigned disabled path and signed Submit/Post path with matching actor role and clean console.
close_reason: Acceptance criteria satisfied: mock Post enforces SignedOriginal and Created actor matches creating session; automated and independent browser QA pass.
